problem: Companion performance acceptance needs plugin recovery latency, but N.E.K.O intentionally owns plugin process lifecycle and does not auto-restart crashed plugins. XiaoYu already has an approved explicit/startup reconcile path that recovers host-declared auto-start plugins only through N.E.K.O refresh/list/start APIs.

authority.plugin_lifecycle: N.E.K.O native plugin host and lifecycle HTTP APIs
authority.measurement: time.monotonic around the already-existing reconcile calls

current_pin.finding: native host classifies crashed state and exposes explicit lifecycle operations; runtime documentation explicitly says crashed plugins are not automatically restarted

latest_upstream_checked.finding: latest upstream still documents no automatic crash restart and exposes no restart-on-crash policy marker; do not introduce a second supervisor

behavior: stamp total explicit/startup reconcile elapsed time without adding requests
record initial host-declared non-running auto-start plugins and which were recovered
publish recovery elapsed time only when a real non-running set existed, final host state was confirmed, and every candidate recovered
normalize plugin.reconcile_ms and plugin.recovery_ms into the existing explicit-budget evaluator
treat non-PASS reconcile results as source errors

acceptance: healthy already-running plugins do not claim a recovery latency
crashed/stopped host-declared auto-start plugins recovered through the native start API produce a bounded recovery measurement
no additional HTTP request is introduced for measurement
no watchdog, daemon, polling loop, process manager or plugin lifecycle authority is added
ordinary agent push already executes both reconcile and performance contract test modules
retirement_condition: Retire XiaoYu recovery timing when N.E.K.O exposes native crash-recovery timing/product telemetry or a host-owned restart policy and release verdict that can be consumed directly.
